payload.body:
ic to vc: ST0002/WP05, predict, is LANDED on main by fast-forward in d57a014..258e0a7, which is ST0002's whole remaining stack. WP05's commits there are 9cd35e1 (the two WP03 follow-ups you asked for), 447b20f (predict) and 258e0a7 (AT-05.2's fixture). cc signed predict's arithmetic on its meaning before the build.
- RUN: one Desk run covered WP05, WP06, WP08 and WP07 in slot 01M7A1JYDSQNNHNNN55ACXCX40 (released 09:29Z, with an END to devbin-vc). It PASSED at 70adaf7, which is the landed code: git diff 70adaf7 main over src, tests, the Cargo files, README, CHANGELOG and herdr is empty. fmt --check, clippy --all-targets -D warnings and cargo test --no-fail-fast each exit 0, with 84 unit tests passed (2 ignored) and 45 cli tests passed. All 19 mutants went red, each against its own test. At 4589212 one mutant survived: p5, the climb not held at the cap. The fixture's 2% an hour reached the cap on a whole second, so the step to it never overshot. 258e0a7 (tested as 70adaf7) sets 3.5% an hour, whose climb ends part way through a second, and asserts that premise. The checks and AT-05.2's three mutants were re-run there. The other 16 mutants ran at 4589212; the code and tests they touch are unchanged since.
- WP03'S FOLLOW-UPS (9cd35e1): an account's line gives the percent used, then the headroom as what is below the cap, eg "work: 48% used, 48% below the 95% cap, resets in 1d23h, Fable 10% used, soonest reset with headroom". Under --model, the model's scoped window can bound the headroom, so the line reads "N% more on Fable before the cap", and the two figures never claim to add up. Per hv's ruling 3, an unknown account's line lists the windows its usage reports, eg "free: unknown, session 40% used, no weekly window in the usage". The new CLI test which_lists_an_account_without_a_weekly_window_with_what_it_reports_and_never_chooses_it checks that line, its JSON (state unknown, cause no_weekly_window, rank null, its session window) and that the account is never chosen. The JSON's time form and its rounding to 0.1 moved to display, so which and predict share them.
- PREDICT (447b20f): predict::rate sums the rises in the weekly windows across every account and divides by the hours the history spans. A rise across a reset counts from 0, a fall counts as none, and the first sample adds nothing. With under a day of span (MIN_SPAN, defined once) or no rise, the text says so plainly ("Too little history to project: ..."), nothing is projected, and it exits 0. predict::project steps event by event from now to the last of the current resets. At each step which::choose itself picks the account, from the projected state written as fresh reports. The chosen account climbs at the rate until the cap or a reset, and a window that resets starts again at 0 a week later. Each account's unused share at its current reset is 100 less its projected percent, so it counts what the cap leaves too, and the total is the sum. An account the rule cannot use now is left out, with why. The text says what the rate rests on (samples and hours) and that it assumes every account is on one plan. The JSON is versioned as which's is: version, now, cap, rate {percent_per_hour, samples, hours}, accounts [{name, percent, resets_at, projected, unused}], unused, and left_out [{name, reason}]. With too little history, percent_per_hour and unused are null and no account is projected.
- THE PLAN TIER: cc's todo 3b gives each report subscription_type and rate_limit_tier (signed). On your sequencing, predict's grouping (my todo 3) is written on cc's rebased follow-up, unbuilt, and rides cc's WP04 run. Until then predict's text says it assumes every account is on one plan.
- ACCEPTANCE: AT-05.1, AT-05.2 and AT-05.3 cover AC-05.1, which is satisfied. AT-05.1 is the rate, with its expected value computed from the fixture. AT-05.2 is the projection: each account's projected percent held at the cap, its unused share and the total, all computed from the fixture. AT-05.3 is the CLI: too little history said plainly with exit 0, then the rate, what it rests on, each account's unused share and the total, in text and JSON. The landing moved seven earlier rows (AT-01.4, AT-02.4, AT-03.1 to 03.4 and AT-04.4); I re-cited them at eb9dc0d along with minting the new rows. intent at lint ST0002 is ok on 26 of 26 rows. wp done is yours after your read.
- PLEASE READ: src/predict.rs whole, src/predict/view.rs, which/view.rs's line, cli.rs's predict arm, and the predict and ruling-3 CLI tests.
- NEXT: WP06, WP08 and WP07 follow, one message each.
